scope: Native multiline provider and experimental pinned-browser editing bindings

implementation.native: Ordinary NSTextView inside ordinary NSScrollView. Native layout, wrapping, selection, key interpretation, scrollbar placement/tracking and clipping remain in installed GNUstep/AppKit.
implementation.host: Composite recursive native backing and hit testing; focus targets the document view. No native controls or UI algorithms copied into adapters.
implementation.viewport: Optional native document/visible-rect query and NSClipView constraint/scroll forwarding; transport operations 32/33 preserve ownership and original request layout. Browser layout/DOM synchronization remains open.
implementation.compatibility: ABI 1 append-only extension: 384 to 408 bytes on ARM64, text capabilities 31. Older provider rejects kind 9, reports no multiline and returns unavailable viewport operations. Existing field/password text, filter, command, menu, range and input regressions pass.
implementation.chromium: Exact textarea vtable/value/default-event boundaries; inherited TextControlElement selection methods. Compiled textarea painter tail-calls existing guarded text-field painter. Native selectors map to real InsertNewline/InsertTab engine commands, preserving beforeinput/undo/controller paths.
implementation.firefox: Exact textarea value/editor/post-event/controller calls. Common TextControlState selection getter avoids nontrivial Nullable return ABI; state at +304 versus input +352. Newline calls real InsertLineBreakAsAction. Native clipboard validation uses textarea-specific GetControllers; execution reuses common DoCommandCallback.
implementation.guards: Existing build-ID guard plus fresh bounded instruction guards. Firefox guards run after libxul is loaded, rather than in the preload constructor. No browser debug symbols loaded into GDB; a small compositor trace confirmed delivery while diagnosing test focus.
implementation.browser_scope: Opt-in on the pinned browser binaries. Native multiline transactions and real-seat keyboard behavior qualified in the synthetic fixture; whole text-area/browser integration remains unfinished.

remaining: Connect native viewport/document geometry to each browser DOM scroll and layout contract, including scrollTop/scrollLeft/scrollHeight, complete scrollbar ownership and scroll events.

Qualify textarea browser pixels, pointer dragging/autoscroll, resize, disabled state, wrap modes and styling; current independent pixel and native-scrollbar pointer references qualify the provider, not the complete browser embedding.
Remove Firefox original auto-hidden menu-bar interference after native Alt shortcuts. The independent clipboard cases currently dismiss it and select the actual browser pane before content focus.
Multiline Undo/Redo and broader text commands; IME, rich text/contenteditable, accessibility, mixed output scaling, other browser frontend controls, dialogs and installed-desktop integration.
Automatic adapter installation/build selection; Chrome, Vivaldi and Firefox derivatives remain unqualified. Continue remaining GTK/Qt/KDE applications after the browser families.
